blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Port Coquitlam total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Woodland Acres Houses: the housing stock

items.t: The houses here are governed by the City's RS zones in Zoning Bylaw No. 3630: minimum lot width is 15 metres in RS1, 12 metres in RS2, 30 metres in RS3 and 9.5 metres in RS4, and the zone on the specific lot decides what the lot can hold.
Apartments sit in the RA1 and RA2 zones and townhouses in the RTh1 to RTh3 zones under the same bylaw, so the detached stock is the RS-zone stock by definition.

blocks.text: Woodland Acres Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: School District No. 43 (SD43) assigns catchments by address, so the schools for a Woodland Acres address are confirmed in the district locator rather than by the sub-area name.

blocks.text: Woodland Acres Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The City's utility model is unusual in the region: water and sewer are flat annual fees billed separately from property taxes, due March 31, 2026, rather than metered charges on the tax bill.
The RS zone widths vary widely inside one bylaw — 9.5 metres in RS4 to 30 metres in RS3 — so two Woodland Acres lots can carry very different subdivision potential.
Coast Meridian Road and its overpass are the north side's connection to Lougheed Highway and the Mary Hill Bypass for this part of Port Coquitlam.
The Traboulay PoCo Trail is the city's riverfront trail system, the walking and cycling frame for the city's river-side areas.
